description: Maps public capability claims in README.md / AGENTS.md / SKILL.md to concrete automated verification tests so zero claims drift unverified.

claims.claim: Semantic AST Diff Guard blocks assertion weakening (S5->S2/S1), S0 tautologies, test.fail(), expect.soft(), swallowed .catch(), retry inflation, and config tampering
Layer 0 .aitest/governance.lock prevents AI Agents from modifying protected configs/waivers/fixtures and blocks MCP self-approval
Run Ledger binds reports/results.json to ULID runId and workspace input hash, rejecting stale green results after code edits
claims.testTitleSubstring: Run Ledger binds results.json to runId

claims.claim: Real Chromium Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP) captured via pre-injected buffered PerformanceObserver
claims.testTitleSubstring: captures real non-null LCP via PerformanceObserver

claims.claim: expectAccessible enforces WCAG 2.0, 2.1, and 2.2 Level A & AA axe-core tags
Zero-to-One Explorer default-denies all non-GET/HEAD requests, blocks GraphQL mutations, and enforces outbound egress allowlist
Redaction v2 strips JSON passwords, JWTs, SaaS API tokens, PEM private keys, cookies, and URL secrets
MCP Job Runner supports async backgrounding, progress notifications, process-tree cancellation, concurrent read tools, and workspace root boundaries
Stateful Heal Session enforces 0% C/D mis-heal rate and <= 3 Class-A repair attempts
claims.testTitleSubstring: Heal Session State Machine enforces 0% C-class mis-heal rate

claims.claim: Impact v2 traces reverse static import dependency chains to select affected specs with explainable provenance
Living Code Map v4 preserves dynamic routes (:id / [id]), prunes deleted routes, and converges defects without seenCount inflation
Requirement Traceability Matrix maps specs/REQ-xxx IDs to Playwright test specs and runtime outcomes
